notes: Machine-readable catalog of the m-next design system. Intended for AI agents and tooling that need a single-file orientation to the workspace. Each `components` entry tells you: what the component is, when to use it, what to avoid using instead, where the canonical Storybook example lives, and what variants exist. Update this file whenever a component is added, renamed, or has its variant surface changed. The longer-form Selection guide lives in AGENTS.md (workspace root).

categories.Foundation: Primitives — tokens, theme, layout, text. Used by everything.
categories.Action: Buttons, links, triggers. Things you click.
categories.Display: Content presentation — cards, badges, grids, charts.
categories.Feedback: State communication — banners, alerts, spinners, toasts, empty states.
categories.Form: User input capture — inputs, checkboxes, selects, dates.
categories.Navigation: Moving between views — tabs, sidebar, breadcrumbs, pagination.
categories.Overlay: Floating above content — dialogs, drawers, popovers, menus.
categories.Domain: Domain-specific or specialized — calendar, color picker, signature, html editor.

components.name: Box
components.summary: Polymorphic block-level container with spacing/sizing props.
components.use: Generic flex/block container with padding, background, dimensions.
components.dontUse: Don't reach for a styled <div> when Box covers it.

components.name: Stack
components.summary: Vertical flex container with gap.
components.use: Vertical groups of content with consistent spacing.
components.dontUse: Don't use a styled <div> with flex-direction:column.

components.name: Inline
components.summary: Horizontal flex container with gap, align, justify, wrap.
components.use: Horizontal row of items (toolbar, header strip, inline form row).
components.dontUse: Don't use a styled <div> with flex-direction:row.

components.name: Flex
components.summary: Lower-level flex primitive — direction, gap, align, justify, wrap props.
components.use: When Stack/Inline don't fit and you need explicit flex direction.
components.dontUse: Prefer Stack or Inline when possible — they're more semantic.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: Horizontal rule between sections.
components.use: Visual separator between groups of content.
components.dontUse: Don't use border-bottom on a sibling div.

components.name: Text
components.summary:
Typography primitive. Renders

,

, or

–

with theme-token-driven font size, weight, color.
components.use: All themed typography — headings, paragraphs, helper text.
components.dontUse:
Don't use

/

with inline style — use for theme-token typography.

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.summary: Context provider for theme tokens. Pair with useTheme().
components.use: Wrap your app root (or a story) to enable theme-aware components.
components.dontUse: Don't pass theme objects as props — use the provider.

components.name: MethodLogo
components.summary: Method wordmark image wrapper. Defaults to white-on-navy CDN asset.
components.use: Sidebar header, app-bar start, login splash, anywhere the Method mark goes.
components.dontUse: Don't inline the SVG or rebuild the wordmark.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Clickable action trigger. Five variants for emphasis level.
components.use: Any clickable action — primary form action, cancel, low-emphasis text+icon, etc.
components.dontUse: Don't use <button style={...}> for any variant. Pick a variant.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Group of related buttons with shared chrome.
components.use: Grouped actions like "edit / share / archive".
components.dontUse: Don't use an Inline of <Button>s when ButtonGroup is the right semantic.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Navigation anchor with optional external-link icon.
components.use: Inline navigation links in prose, table cells, etc.
components.dontUse: Don't use bare <a href> with custom underline styling.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Small categorical tag.
components.use: Small static status indicators (VIP, NEW, BETA).
components.dontUse: Don't use <Pill> for small categorical tags — Pill is larger and interactive.

components.name: Pill
components.summary: Larger tag with optional icons and dismiss action.
components.use: Interactive or dismissible tags (selected filters, removable chips, status with action).
components.dontUse: Don't use <Badge> when you need a dismiss action — Badge is static.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Generic content panel.
components.use: Grouped content with a border and padding.
components.dontUse: Don't use <Card> for metric/KPI callouts — use <InsightCard>.

components.name: InsightCard
components.summary: Metric/KPI card with title, value, and optional delta (trend) slot.
components.use: Dashboard KPIs — "Total revenue $84,250 +12% vs last month".
components.dontUse: Don't use <Card> with manual metric layout.

components.name: Container
components.summary: Full-width bordered/padded content container.
components.use: Bordered content panel; use the bordered prop for a card-like surface.
components.dontUse: Don't use a styled <div> with border.

components.name: Grid
components.summary: Tabular data grid with sort, filter, pagination, view filters, columns toggle, inline export, search.
components.use: Any tabular data view. See the Readonly story for canonical wiring.
components.dontUse: Don't build a <table> or div-shaped grid. Don't duplicate Grid's built-in chrome with a custom header.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Expandable sections.
components.use: Collapsible FAQ-style content or stacked settings panels.
components.dontUse: Don't roll your own collapse logic.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Horizontal scrolling image/card carousel.
components.use: Image galleries, content sliders.
components.dontUse: Don't use scroll-snap on a div.

components.name: AvatarPill
components.summary: Avatar image plus name in a pill shape.
components.use: Person identification in lists, comment author, assigned-to chips.
components.dontUse: Don't use with a manual for person tags.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.summary: Page section heading with optional title, subtitle, and action slot.
components.use: Above content sections — "Contact Details" with an Edit action on the right.
components.dontUse: Don't compose <h2> + flex container manually.

components.name: TagWidget
components.summary: Read-only tag list display.
components.use: Showing assigned tags on a record in a read-only context.
components.dontUse: Use <ChipsFilter> for interactive tag selection.

components.name: Chart
components.summary: Multi-series Highcharts wrapper — line, bar, pie, etc.
components.use: Time-series and categorical data visualization.
components.dontUse: Don't roll custom SVG charts.

components.name: ChartDrilldown
components.summary: Hierarchical drill-down chart.
components.use: Charts where the user can click a category to expand into subcategories.
components.dontUse: Use <Chart> for non-drilldown cases — simpler.

components.name: Image
components.summary: Image display with optional edit overlay.
components.use: Avatar editing, product photo display.
components.dontUse: Use a plain for non-editable static images.

components.name: Scrollbar
components.summary: Custom scrollbar styling wrapper.
components.use: When you need themed scrollbars in a scrolling container.
components.dontUse: Don't reach for it unless the default scrollbar is visually wrong.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline contextual alert with status accent and optional title/action.
components.use: Inline contextual feedback within a form or content area.
components.dontUse: Don't use <Banner> for inline alerts — Banner is page-top.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: Full-width page-top notification with optional close and CTAs.
components.use: Page-top notifications — trial expiry, system status, dismissable info.
components.dontUse: Don't use <Banner> for inline contextual feedback — use <Alert>.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Transient toast notifications managed by ToastProvider + useToast() hook.
components.use: Success confirmations, error notifications, transient feedback.
components.dontUse: Don't render alert divs manually — call useToast().success().

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Circular loading spinner.
components.use: Inline loading state (button, small region).
components.dontUse: Don't use a CSS animation div.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Placeholder skeleton for content that's loading.
components.use: Loading state for lists, cards, structured content.
components.dontUse: Don't use a gray <Box> as a manual skeleton.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Centered empty/no-results state with title, description, and action slot.
components.use: When a list is empty, a search returned nothing, or a feature isn't activated.
components.dontUse: Don't hand-roll "No items found" markup.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Hover-triggered info popup.
components.use: Hint text for icon buttons, contextual help on hover.
components.dontUse: Don't use the native title="" attribute or a custom <Popover>.

components.name: AppActivationBanner
components.summary: "Try this feature" splash card with title, description, bullet points, CTA buttons.
components.use: Empty-state promotion of an unactivated feature (e.g. "Set up Customers & Leads").
components.dontUse: Don't build a custom <Container> with bullets and CTAs.

components.name: HeroBanner
components.summary: Large hero section with title, subtitle, background image slot.
components.use: Top-of-page hero on landing screens.
components.dontUse: Don't use for inline notifications — that's <Banner>.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Single-line text input with leftContent/rightContent slots.
components.use: Standard text entry fields.
components.dontUse: Don't use bare <input type="text"> with custom styling.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text input with rows control.
components.use: Notes, descriptions, longer-form text.
components.dontUse: Don't use bare <textarea>.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Single checkbox with label and onChange callback.
components.use: Standalone boolean toggles in a form.
components.dontUse: Don't use <input type="checkbox"> with manual labeling.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.summary: Group of checkboxes with shared label.
components.use: Multi-select via checkboxes ("Select all that apply").
components.dontUse: Don't compose multiple <Checkbox>s in a flex container.

components.name: RadioButton
components.summary: Single radio with label.
components.use: Mutually exclusive choice within a RadioGroup.
components.dontUse: Use <SegmentedControl> for inline 2–4 choices.

components.name: IconRadioGroup
components.summary: Radio group rendered as icon-based selection tiles.
components.use: Visual mutually-exclusive choice (e.g. layout picker).
components.dontUse: Don't use bare radio buttons when icons better convey meaning.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: On/off switch.
components.use: Binary settings — "Account is active", "Email notifications".
components.dontUse: Don't style a <Checkbox> to look like a switch.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Single-select dropdown.
components.use: Pick-one from a static list.
components.dontUse: Don't use <select> directly.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.summary: Multi-select dropdown with chips for selected values.
components.use: Pick-many from a list (tags, categories, assignees).
components.dontUse: Don't use multiple <Checkbox>s when the list is long.

components.name: Dropdown
components.summary: Async-capable dropdown. Includes DropdownAsync and ClickToEditDropdown variants.
components.use: Dropdowns with remote-loaded options or click-to-edit cells.
components.dontUse: Use <Select> for static client-side options.

components.name: SearchInput
components.summary: Input with built-in search icon and clear control.
components.use: List search, filter search, anywhere with a search affordance.
components.dontUse: Don't use <Input> with manual magnifier icon.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: Pill-style segmented toggle for 2–4 mutually exclusive inline options.
components.use: Inline filter switches ("All / Open / Paid / Overdue").
components.dontUse: Use <RadioButton> for vertical/labeled groups; <Tabs> for navigating views.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Date input with calendar popover. Also exports DateRangePicker, TimePicker, TimeRangePicker, DatePickerCalendar.
components.use: Any date or time input.
components.dontUse: Don't use <input type="date"> — inconsistent across browsers.

components.name: PhoneInput
components.summary: Phone number input with country code selector.
components.use: Phone fields anywhere.
components.dontUse: Don't use <Input> with manual phone formatting.

components.name: Address
components.summary: Multi-field address display/edit component.
components.use: Read or edit a structured address (street, city, region, postal, country).
components.dontUse: Don't compose separate <Input>s — Address handles the grouping.

components.name: AddressLookup
components.summary: Autocomplete address field backed by a geocoding service.
components.use: Single-field address entry with autocomplete suggestions.
components.dontUse: Use <Address> for fully manual multi-field entry.

components.name: FormField
components.summary: Wraps a form control with label, description, and validation slots.
components.use: Every form input — labels and errors should go through FormField.
components.dontUse: Don't wrap inputs with custom <label> + <div> + error text.

components.name: FormSection
components.summary: Grouped fields under a section title with optional description.
components.use: Form sections ("Personal info", "Preferences") that group multiple FormFields.
components.dontUse: Don't use <fieldset> directly.

components.name: ValidationMessage
components.summary: Inline validation message (error, warning, success).
components.use: Below a form field when explaining a validation result.
components.dontUse: Don't use a red <span> manually.

components.name: Caption
components.summary: Small helper text typically rendered below a form field.
components.use: Hint or helper text under inputs.
components.dontUse: Don't use a small gray <span> manually.

components.name: Attachments
components.summary: File upload widget with file list display.
components.use: Document/photo attachment fields on records.
components.dontUse: Don't use <input type="file"> directly.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tab strip with content panel. Pass tabList, selectedTab, onChange, onRenderTabContent.
components.use: Switching between views within a screen (Activities / Opportunities / Invoices).
components.dontUse: Don't build custom tab buttons + state. Don't pass onRenderTabContent={() => null} to suppress the panel — omit the prop entirely.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: Navigation breadcrumb trail with separators.
components.use: Path indicator above page content (Dashboard > Customers > Acme Corp).
components.dontUse: Don't compose <Link>s with manual › separators.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page-of-results navigation. Note: @m-next/grid has built-in pagination — only use this for non-Grid lists.
components.use: Custom paged lists outside of Grid.
components.dontUse: Don't duplicate Grid's built-in pagination chrome.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Multi-step workflow indicator with steps array and activeStep index.
components.use: Onboarding flows, multi-step setup, progress indication.
components.dontUse: Don't roll numbered circles in a flex row.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: Left-side app navigation. Compound: Sidebar.Header / Body / Footer / Divider / Group / Item.
components.use: Primary left-rail navigation for app shells.
components.dontUse: Don't compose <nav> with manual <ul>/<li>. Don't pass a header={...} data prop — use the compound API.

components.name: AppBar
components.summary: Top app bar with Start, Center, End slots.
components.use: Top chrome of an app shell — page title on Start, utility buttons on End.
components.dontUse: Don't use a <header> flex container.

components.name: MenuList
components.summary: Dropdown menu list. Package also exports MenuItem and IconMenuList.
components.use: Action menus, kebab-menus, contextual menu lists.
components.dontUse: Don't compose a <Popover> with manual list items.

components.name: ChipsFilter
components.summary: Horizontal row of filter chips. Also exported as FilterChips alias.
components.use: Filter selector above a list view.
components.dontUse: Don't use a row of <Checkbox>s.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Modal dialog with backdrop, title, and body.
components.use: Confirmation, form modals, destructive action prompts.
components.dontUse: Don't build a fixed <div> with backdrop.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Slide-out side panel. Placement (left/right) and size props.
components.use: Side-panel for detail views, settings, multi-step forms.
components.dontUse: Don't build a fixed <div> with a transition.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Floating positioned content bubble.
components.use: Custom popovers that aren't menus or tooltips.
components.dontUse: Use <Menu> for action lists, <Tooltip> for hover hints.

components.name: AppActivationOverlay
components.summary: Full-screen "Try this feature" splash overlay.
components.use: First-time-feature-use promotion that takes over the screen.
components.dontUse: Use <AppActivationBanner> for inline (non-blocking) promotion.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: Full calendar widget backed by Syncfusion.
components.use: Month/week/day calendar views with events.
components.dontUse: Use <DatePicker> for simple date entry.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.summary: Color selection widget.
components.use: Theming controls, custom branding pickers.
components.dontUse: Don't use <input type="color">.

components.name: Signature
components.summary: Signature capture canvas.
components.use: E-signatures on contracts, work orders.
components.dontUse: Don't roll a canvas wrapper.

components.name: HtmlEditor
components.summary: Rich-text WYSIWYG editor.
components.use: Email composition, rich descriptions, formatted notes.
components.dontUse: Don't use contenteditable directly.

components.name: Mapbox
components.summary: Mapbox integration wrapper. Package also exports MapboxApi.
components.use: Map displays, location pickers, geo-tagged record visualization.
components.dontUse: Don't embed Mapbox directly.

components.name: SvgIcon
components.summary: Icon sprite wrapper. Takes name, size, color.
components.use: Any iconography. Use color="currentColor" inside Buttons so icon color follows the variant.
components.dontUse: Don't inline custom <svg> markup.

components.name: SyncWidget
components.summary: Sync status indicator showing last-sync timestamp and refresh action.
components.use: Header indicator for data that syncs with an external system (e.g. QuickBooks).
components.dontUse: Don't build a custom "last synced" string.

components.name: Typeography
components.summary: DEPRECATED. Legacy V-prefixed alias for @m-next/text. Fires console.warn on render.
components.use: Don't use. Migrate to @m-next/text.
components.dontUse: Use <Text> from @m-next/text instead.

components.name: TabsV2
components.summary: DEPRECATED. Alias for @m-next/tabs (V2 features absorbed during Phase 3). Fires console.warn on render.
components.use: Don't use. Migrate to @m-next/tabs.
components.dontUse: Use <Tabs> from @m-next/tabs instead.

compositions.name: CustomersList
compositions.summary: List view shell: AppBar + Sidebar + activation banner + tabs over a real Grid with view filters.

compositions.name: ContactDetail
compositions.summary: Split-view detail screen: left rail of FormField + Text fields, right pane with Tabs over an EmptyState.

compositions.name: Dashboard
compositions.summary: Overview screen: row of InsightCard KPIs with deltas, two-column 'recent activity + today' panels using bordered Container.

conventions.packageNaming: Every component package is @m-next/<kebab-case-name>. Some packages export multiple components (e.g. @m-next/radio-button exports RadioButton + IconRadioGroup + ButtonRadioGroup).
conventions.storyTitles: All Storybook story titles follow m-next/Components/<Category>/<Name>, or m-next/Foundation/<Name>, or m-next/Compositions/<Name>.
conventions.intentMdx: Per-component intent contracts live at packages/<name>/stories/<name>.mdx — discoverable by convention, not listed here.
conventions.types: Public API types live at packages/<name>/src/index.d.ts — discoverable by convention, not listed here.
conventions.envelope: Every cleaned component forwardRefs, accepts an optional id (auto-generated when omitted), soft-shims a legacy `forwardRef` prop with a one-time console.warn, and silently ignores legacy ghost props (isV4Design, isMobile, legacyClass, displayAuto, compactStyle, hidden).
conventions.imports: ALWAYS use a named import: import { Button } from '@m-next/button'. Every component in this registry is exported by name from its package — the `import` field on each entry is the exact, verified line to copy. Most packages ALSO have a default export for backwards compatibility, but do not use it: the two forms are not interchangeable across the library and the default is not documented per-component.
